0022600140.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (0-2, 5th in the Southwest, 2.5 games back, 11th in the West) host the Denver Nuggets (0-1, 5th in the Northwest, 1.5 games back, 12th in the West) in New Orleans' fourth game of the season, with the Pelicans on a two-game losing streak. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Pelicans lost all three meetings 0-3, most recently 122-116 in New Orleans on 2026-01-13. Yves Missi is out for New Orleans with a knee bruise, and Julian Strawther is out for Denver with a knee sprain.
